comparison.objective: Transfer a filament spool between hands and slide its bore over a side-holder rod to the stop; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-reach regrasping and close-clearance peg threading versus narrow mandrel alignment, bimanual impact control, fracture, and loose-fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Spool fully on the rod at its stop and released versus four contact-driven fractures, four contained tangs, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Both require coaxial alignment, but spool placement tests regrasp and insertion, while the candidate tests controlled break-off and recovery.
